decisions.reason: It has stayed on the website for two years and fits the core offer, so results likely met a minimally acceptable aspiration level, though its lighter visibility leaves some chance of later rationalisation.
The firm has retained this faster express option in a growing market, suggesting satisfactory demand relative to aspirations and enough organisational slack to continue it.
A dedicated page in both years and multiple models indicate stronger commitment and performance above aspiration, making withdrawal unlikely.

The digital ordering and service platform supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper advisory and service integration, so a large firm with slack is likely to keep developing rather than drop it.
Its move from a simple mention to a dedicated page signals improving internal evaluation and satisfactory market acceptance, which strongly favors retention.
